name: Pedro-Rodríguez (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist white with three blue wavy stripes, the fly green with a white eradicated pine.
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 14 March 2006 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 186 of 26 September 2006); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, white with three blue wavy stripes at the hoist and green with a white eradicated pine at the fly.
